默认检查 chi_sim+chi_tra+eng；导入时可另选 eng/chi_.en: The default check uses chi_sim+chi_tra+eng. On import, select any supported eng/chi_sim/chi_tra/deu/fra/jpn/rus/lat combination; only the selected language packs are needed. Install Tesseract and the matching traineddata in your operating system. The app does not download system components automatically.
